Name: Lumisteria Custom Set of Walnut Furniture
Author: Lumisteria
TagLine: A custom set of walnut furniture, matching some vanilla ones.
Description:
See my CP version at : https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26505

This mod adds around 50 new furnitures inspired by vanilla ones.

This set use walnut wood and creamy fabric, and lace patterns. Find items like bookcases, an old spinning wheel, comfy armchairs and more bookcases !

You'll need [Custom Furniture](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254)  for this set to work. If the mod isn't up to date, look at https://smapi.io/mods/ for unofficial updates.

***

Consider using my [Interior recolor](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/361)  mod for matching bed and kitchen.

***

Note : the Custom Furniture mod may have some issues, like some items randomly becoming
other items. The issue isn't on my side and i have no control on it.

***

 Special thanks to :
- All the discord channel of stardew valley for their help, advices and feedbacks, as usual.
- Mouse, always helpful.
